quote: every text cell, header and preamble value passes formula protection (a leading `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab or carriage return gets an apostrophe) and the CSV writer quotes commas, quotes and line breaks
reason: The claim is only about what the decision record says, and D09-08 states it word for word. The numeric-cell exception covers money, quantity and count cells, not text cells, so it does not contradict 'every text cell'. Version 2 shows the leading-space gap was later fixed. It does not weaken what the record says.
